title: Lightweight, Refractory High-Entropy Alloy, CrNbTa0.25TiZr, with High Yield Strength
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc-melting under a titanium getter argon atmosphere, melted four times in a water-cooled copper crucible. The as-cast samples were annealed under vacuum at 1000 ℃ for 20 h.
